mentions.name: Augsentric
mentions.description: An all-in-one platform that runs multiple checks on a website or domain—covering SSL, HTML, SEO, and redirects—extended with monitoring, change detection, and alerting. Available to try for free.
mentions.problem: Having to run different website checks in different places to ensure everything is as it should be.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on an all in one "platform" that runs multiple different checks on a website/domain. Got sick of having to run different checks in different places to ensure everything is at it should be - SSL, HTML, SEO, redirects etc.

Extended the checking to monitoring and change detection/alerting. You can try for free at https://www.augsentric.com
